display.purpose: Topic name in the detail header (text-xl). The largest and rarest type.

body.purpose: Primary control and content text (text-sm). Reading floor for interactive content.

label.purpose: Form field labels, badges, helper text (text-xs). Compact but AA-safe.

mono.purpose: Event payloads, session IDs, timestamps, template previews. Fixed-width so streams align like logs.

shadows.name: toast-lift
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system; lifts the transient toast stack above the flat instrument.

motion.name: transition-colors
motion.purpose: Default state transitions (hover, focus, active). Quick to stay in the developer's flow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single actionable CTA. Signal Blue carries the accent; everything else is secondary.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff; font: 500 14px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6366f1; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #4338ca; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral non-primary action (Browse retained, Refresh, Start/Stop source). No accent color.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #27272a; color: #d4d4d8; font: 500 12px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 6px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #3f3f46; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #52525b; }

components.name: Danger Confirm Button
components.description: Destructive action wrapped in a two-step confirm gate. Arming flips label to 'confirm' + 'cancel'.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.2); color: #f87171; font: 400 12px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(248,113,113,0.4); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.3); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text/option field. Focus shifts border to Signal Blue with a subtle ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #09090b; color: #f4f4f5; font: 400 14px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 12px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #3f3f46; border-radius: 6px; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #52525b; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #6366f1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(99,102,241,0.3); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact tag signalling one state: live (emerald), stopped (zinc), test (amber), error (red). Color is the payload.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font: 500 12px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0 6px; height: 18px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(52,211,153,0.1); color: #34d399; border: 1px solid rgba(52,211,153,0.3); }

components.name: Card Panel
components.description: A row container (source, subscription, event). Flat tone on the canvas; hover lifts slightly.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(24,24,27,0.3); color: #d4d4d8; font: 400 14px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(63,63,70,0.5); border-radius: 8px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { background: rgba(39,39,42,0.3); }

components.name: Tab Rule
components.description: Active tab is a single 2px Signal Blue bottom rule. Inactive tabs are muted text with no fill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(63,63,70,0.5); } .ds-nav-item { font: 500 14px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 16px 10px; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #71717a; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #e4e4e7; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { border-bottom-color: #4f46e5; color: #e4e4e7; }

components.name: Agent Pill
components.description: Agent selector (pi/claude/codex) with distinct identity colors. Selected state uses a ring inset.
components.css: .ds-pill { font: 500 12px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: #27272a; color: #a1a1aa; border: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(63,63,70,0.5); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-pill:hover { background: #3f3f46; } .ds-pill.is-selected { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(251,191,36,0.4); background: rgba(251,191,36,0.2); color: #fbbf24; }

narrative.overview: agent-message-broker is a local-first exchange where event signals are routed from sources to live coding-agent sessions. The interface is a control room that mirrors the terminal the developer already lives in. Every surface is a channel; every accent is a confirmed signal whether something is live, flowing, waiting, or down. This is an Operate surface: the developer comes to complete a task, not to be entertained. The system earns its craft through practiced restraint: a dark zinc canvas calibrated to reduce glare for hours-long sessions, an indigo primary that means only one thing (the actionable path), and a strict semantic language where green means live, amber means test/manual, and red means error/destructive. Density is a feature; nothing decorative.
keyCharacteristics: A dark, high-contrast zinc instrument panel tuned for long developer sessions
Indigo (Signal Blue) reserved strictly for primary actionable paths
Semantic status color as the only personality: live/connected green, test amber, error red, codex purple
Terminal-honest typography: sans for chrome, monospace for data
Structure communicates routing: a topic is a channel and everything about it lives in one surface

rules.name: The Signal Blue Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the actionable path, and only the actionable path. If a stroke of indigo does not lead to a user action, remove it. Its rarity is what makes the CTA obvious.

rules.name: The Semantic Only Rule
rules.body: Color carries meaning or it is absent. Green means live, amber means manual, red means error. If a color is not communicating one of those, it comes out.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace renders only data and code: event payloads, session IDs, timestamps. Chrome and labels stay in the system sans.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: Secondary and label text never falls below 12px. Metadata sits visually subordinated through color and weight, never by shrinking below the legible floor.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are tonally separated, not shadowed. Depth comes from raised fills and borders on the canvas. The only shadow is the transient toast.

dos: Do use Signal Blue for the one primary action on a surface. Every other button is secondary or danger.
Do use text-xs for metadata and labels. Use color (zinc-500/600) for de-emphasis, never size.
Do use monospace for event payloads, session IDs, timestamps, and template previews.
Do use two-step confirm on all destructive actions (delete source, delete subscription, delete topic).
Do keep the flat-by-default elevation. Only the toast earns a shadow.
donts: Don't use Signal Blue for passive links, helper text, or decorative chrome. The accent is the actionable path.
Don't use glyph emoji as icons. Text labels and typographic characters are acceptable; drawn icons belong in a future icon system.
Don't use text-[10px] or any size below 12px for user-facing text.
Don't add shadows to panels, cards, or the sidebar. Tonal separation is sufficient.
Don't use a display font or any font beyond the system sans + monospace pair.
